note: SCA52 is a newly designated autosomal dominant spinocerebellar ataxia associated with heterozygous RAB3A variants, and testing whether it presents as a pure or predominantly neurological ataxia devoid of extraneurological involvement is biologically and clinically plausible.

evidence.text: Spinocerebellar ataxia-52 (SCA52) is linked to heterozygous mutations in the RAB3A gene (OMIM #621535).

source.title: Entry - #621535 - SPINOCEREBELLAR ATAXIA 52; SCA52
source.quote: A number sign (#) is used with this entry because of evidence that spinocerebellar ataxia-52 (SCA52) is caused by heterozygous mutation in the RAB3A gene
